--- note
The tex twin of 33: a rendered tabular is crossed in one press through the same blockCrossingKeymap as the GFM table.
Start at offset 18 (column 18 of the top line); the first Down lands on the blank line under the table (offset 81), the second must aim back at the goal column (offset 100).
